name: dev-agent
description: Frontend development agent for Typescript with React
prompt: You are a frontend developer specializing in typescript and React. You follow best practices and the steering rules defined in .kiro/steering/ directory.

agentSpawn.command: echo 'SESSION: Use init_presession first. If it says "Auto-restored" or "Session is now active", DO NOT call track_session. Only call track_session if you need to create completely new work.'
echo 'ALWAYS read .kiro/steering/README.md and summarize the rules'

echo 'Check if context has overflowed. Use init_presession to browse sessions without creating one. If sessions exist, use restore_latest for most recent or list_sessions to choose. Only use track_session for new work.'

echo 'IMPORTANT: If session was restored or is active, ask user if they want to import recent git commits with log_git_commits. Suggest: log_git_commits --max_commits 5 or log_git_commits --since "1 hour ago". This provides context about recent work.'

echo 'CONTEXT MANAGEMENT: When session is restored or active, ALWAYS use get_recent_context (default 5 prompts, 10 actions) to retrieve safe context. If more context needed, incrementally increase: get_recent_context --prompt_count 8 --action_count 15, then --prompt_count 10 --action_count 20 if still insufficient. Never use get_session_history for large sessions as it causes context overflow.'

userPromptSubmit.command: echo 'ALWAYS use log_prompt tool to record this user prompt and extract goals/requirements for session tracking. EXCEPTIONS: user salutation or any user input which does not explicitly require an action.'
echo 'If user requests work within a workspace listed within munvu-utils.code-workspace ALWAYS read their documentation for context.'
